Let <MATH_0001> be a category viewed as a site with the chaotic
topology. Let <MATH_0002> be a sheaf of rings on <MATH_0003>.
Assume for all <MATH_0004> in <MATH_0005> the restriction map
<MATH_0006> is a flat ring map.
Then <MATH_0007> agrees with the subcategory
<MATH_0008> of complexes
whose cohomology sheaves are quasi-coherent.
